# NISP.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp1,476.0 against Rp1,150.0 (expected total return 32.3%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The report states "Net interest income was IDR9.87tn in FY2025 against non-interest income of IDR3.22tn" and "Net interest income still rose on the larger earning asset base, and non-interest income nearly doubled ... [S
- §3 says 3.60% "is the same margin the bank reported for FY2025 once the classification difference between the data pack and the audited accounts is removed [S2]". It is not: the engine's FY2025A nim_line is 3.5098%, so 3
- The base is a stack of three optimistic departures: NIM ~4.0% company-equivalent against a 3.7% guide, credit cost 0.50% against a 0.63% four-year average and every peer, and loan growth 13% against an 8-11% plan and 8.2

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
